title: Command & Conquer: Teil 1: Der Tiberiumkonflikt
overview:
World Domination in a Box...

Command & Conquer continues its quest for World Domination on the Saturn.

Command

Build and better your bases. Unite or divide your forces. Develop and utilise guerrilla tactics and a wealth of potent electronic hardware in your attempt to crush the opposition.

Conquer

Every action can so easily trigger a fast and violent reaction. Every real time battle can so easily rage long and hard. Do you have the agility and stamina to keep up with the pace?

Featuring:
- A powerful soundtrack, eerie atmospherics and musical styles all recorded in Red Book Audio, for superb stereo sound.
- A wide range of missions determined by your choice of allegiance.
- Fast-paced gameplay scrolls at 60 frames per second.
